title: Assessing Social Alignment: Do Personality-Prompted Large Language Models Behave Like Humans?

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to adopt specific Big Five personality traits (e.g., Agreeableness, Openness, Conscientiousness) and measuring how these induced personas skew the models' decision-making behavior in simulated psychological experiments (the Ultimatum Game and the Milgram Experiment) compared to human baselines.
